# On The Block Digital

## About
On The Block Digital is a local business SEO and digital growth company based in Oakland, CA.
Operated by Unified Stack LLC, founded by Jack Tyler.
We help local businesses — restaurants, dentists, law firms, home service providers, and retailers —
get found online, get more calls, and bring more customers through the door.

## Services
- Local SEO (Google Search, Google Maps, AI search visibility)
- Website Performance Optimization (Core Web Vitals, page speed)
- Google Business Profile Setup and Optimization
- ADA/WCAG Accessibility Compliance
- Digital Growth Strategy for Small Businesses
- Content Strategy and Blog Writing for Local Search

## Cities Served
- Oakland, CA (current primary market)
- Expanding to additional Bay Area cities
